source: Open-Meteo Previous Runs API (CC BY 4.0): temperature and 100 m wind speed forecast 48 h ahead at 15 places; Fingrid Open Data API (CC BY 4.0): wind (75), consumption (124), day-ahead forecasts (246, 165), wind capacity (268); Finnish public holidays computed

models.fingrid: Fingrid's own day-ahead forecast, issued at 12:00 Finnish time the day before
models.weather: gradient-boosted trees on the weather forecast 48 h earlier, the calendar (holidays, eves, bridge days, Christmas period, July, sun elevation) and history known at issue time
models.weather_fingrid: Fingrid's forecast plus a heavily regularised learned correction from the same inputs

method: Rolling origin: the last 182 days are forecast with models refitted every 7 days on everything known two days before. Diebold-Mariano test on daily mean absolute errors with Newey-West variance (7 lags); a p-value above 0.05 means the difference from Fingrid could be chance. Six settings of the correction model were tried on this backtest and none beat Fingrid by more than 2 %; the most regularised one is published.
